### God Versus the Idols
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-versus-idols
Passage: Jeremiah 10:6-7
Points:
- God graciously reveals why serving Him is in our best interest rather than merely commanding blind obedience.
- Believers are commanded not to imitate pagan practices or be terrified by celestial omens and astrological signs.
- Handcrafted idols are completely lifeless and powerless, unable to do either harm or good.
- Yahweh is the only true, living God and eternal King who created the universe by His power and wisdom.
- Chasing after false gods stems from human vanity and traps people in groundless fear and spiritual ruin.
